title: Derived reduction of integral complexes modulo powers of the uniformizer
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, a scheme $Y$ and an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the completed coefficient sheaf of rings on the small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with its surjection $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\twoheadrightarrow(A_{E,n})_Y$ and derived category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. A complex $P$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules is *K-flat* if $P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}M$ (the totalized termwise tensor product of sheaves of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) is acyclic for every acyclic complex $M$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules. For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ choose a quasi-isomorphism $P\to K$ with $P$ K-flat (one exists: Stacks Project, Tag 06YS, for any ringed site) and define the *derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$*

$$
 K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}:=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}(A_{E,n})_Y\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n}),
$$

the termwise change of rings along $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\to(A_{E,n})_Y$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], a complex of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules, regarded in the derived category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ of sheaves of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Its independence of the choice of $P$ up to unique isomorphism, and the functor $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ it defines, are part of this construction (Stacks Project, Section 'Flat resolutions', Tag 06YL, and Section 'Derived pullback', Tag 06YV, for the derived pullback along the morphism of ringed sites $(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_{E,n})_Y)\to(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y})$).

source.place: the object $K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$ of node def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed (order 1459); same construction as Bhatt-Scholze, The pro-etale topology for schemes (literature/bhatt-scholze-pro-etale-topology_arXiv-1309.1198.pdf), Section 6.5 before Definition 6.5.1 ($K\otimes^L_{\widehat R}R/\mathfrak m^n$), and Stacks Project, Tag 06YS
